title: Native macOS Diablo II — progress
subtitle: driven by Claude · counts come from code, tests and Ghidra; estimates are marked with ~ · dashed = on branches, not yet verified

bars.label: Game.exe functions named in Ghidra
bars.note: original 1.14b binary; re-queried live from Ghidra (all 11,257 named; the last 22 Warden and module-loader functions were named 2026-10-09, a few names marked unverified)

bars.label: Hedged exe names re-verified against the decompile
bars.note: every hedged row now has a verdict; batch 4 (final) examined 173 table rows: 112 confirmed, 47 corrected in Ghidra, 14 unclear and still marked unverified; earlier batches 1-3 as before (~ estimate of the total)

bars.label: Original source files indexed
bars.note: every assert-string path mapped to modules and functions

bars.label: Source files studied in depth
bars.note: NPC, units, saves, packets, render, sound, combat, level gen, loot, AI, quests, trade, session, skills, hirelings, lighting

bars.label: Level generator proven equal to the real game
bars.note: mazes, Act 1-5 outdoors and presets all match the emulator record for record (427 levels, 30,129 rooms, 0 mismatches), including the seven preset levels and exact maze tiles; landed

bars.label: Real .d2s save: read and write verified
bars.note: 9 sections read; whole file written back byte-for-byte (golem section unverified)

bars.label: NPC interaction features
bars.note: click-walk · greeting · menu · return greeting · vendors · gamble · identify · mercenary hire · quest dialogue ✓ (Act 1)

bars.label: Acts playable end to end (scripted play)
bars.note: Acts 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 each pass a scripted real-combat playthrough on the landed tree (2e50f0e4): Act 1 752 s, Act 2 484 s, Act 3 874 s, Act 4 and the start of Act 5 in the full verify, Act 5 caves 574 s

bars.label: Levels walked by a verify scenario
bars.note: levels a scenario enters (lower bound, counted from scripts/verify.d); includes the whole Act 3 chain (Travincal, Council, Durance, Mephisto, red portal); the 9s-walk scenarios add 39: Act 1 caves, Burial Grounds, Crypt, Mausoleum, Forgotten Tower and Cellars, Monastery to Catacombs 2, Act 2 Palace Cellar 2 / Stony Tombs / Halls 3, Act 3 temples, Act 5 ice caves and Nihlathak temple chain

bars.label: Main quests with logic implemented
bars.note: all 27 main quests: states, triggers, rewards (Act 1, Radament and nine more driven in scenarios); level quest gates now enforced in the engine (Canyon, tombs, Palace, Durance, Worldstone levels)

bars.label: Player skills with engine behaviour
bars.note: 150 of 210 player skills have engine behaviour: Psychic Hammer, Dragon Talon knockback, Cloak of Shadows, Mind Blast, Charge, Corpse Explosion, Smite, Taunt and Redemption re-read from the exe; Revive life roll, Sanctuary (undead filter + knockback), Holy Bolt on allies, Energy Shield absorb, Corpse Explosion falloff, Redemption cost and Smite with Holy Shield now follow the exe (no change to the count: these already ran); all 26 missile movement/hit gaps (Meteor, Blizzard, Volcano, Frozen Orb nova, Bone Wall, shouts, Rabies and others) landed with real function bodies; natural mana regeneration landed; Meteor/Blizzard burning ground now hurts players (PvP fractional carry); skills batch 3 (branch feat/skills-3): Feral Rage and Maul stack by count, Wearwolf and Wearbear toggle, Leap Attack single victim, Dragon Claw and Dragon Tail follow the exe (+7); Leap, Dragon Flight, Thunder Storm, Conversion and the three totem auras re-read and corrected but still partial

bars.label: Monster AI archetypes implemented
bars.note: monai.txt entries with a Go think function (about 60 are stand-ins)

bars.label: Monster AI archetypes ported faithfully
bars.note: ~105 (estimate): batch 6 (branch feat/skills-ai-6) ported the WillOWisp dance (states 4-6) and the Mephisto phase bodies from the exe (2 newly counted); the Shadow Master scoring and candidate stack are ported too but no game host feeds them yet, so it is not counted; Overseer got its quest hook; batch 5 closed the documented gaps of Diablo, Vulture, BloodRaven, Nihlathak, UberIzual and made UberDiablo and UberMephisto the exe-faithful stops (7 newly counted; Izual, Summoner, Duriel, Andariel and Smith were re-read and only got hooks, not counted again); batch 4 ported AssassinSentry, CycleOfLife and JarJar (the last entries still on stand-ins); batch 3 ported 8 more from the exe think functions (DesertTurret, CatapultSpotter, Imp, DeathSentry, DruidBear, DruidWolf, DarkWanderer, BladeCreeper); engine hooks they need are optional host interfaces

bars.label: In-game UI panels matching the original layout
bars.note: 8 of 14 panels checked in a real game window against the original numbers (150 rectangles, 0 deviating, scenario 9f-ui-layout); 3 more (party screen rows, mercenary panel, help screen) have layouts read from the exe and unit tested against golden numbers, not yet seen in a running window; move-gold dialog and NPC menu still unchecked

bars.label: Item generation gaps closed vs the exe
bars.note: 12 of the 12 gaps closed (the last, stat-list aggregation, follows the exe decompile 0x627160 / 0x626c80 and is unit tested, not compared with the running emulator); not wired into every drop path yet

bars.label: Multiplayer playable through the game screen
bars.note: menu host/join on the realm, remote heroes move/cast/chat, kills and ears synced; two-window scenario 9j passes through the menus; the realm world is now per level (a hero only receives and affects its level, level change handoff, heroes in other levels hidden, party/roster global) with two-client unit tests (feat/realm-per-level), not yet seen in two game windows (96-multiplayer, 9j-realm-multiplayer, 9d-party-trade, 9f-pvp-skills-ear still to run alone); trade works over the legacy path

bars.label: Mac app: build, Finder launch with real maps, disk image
bars.note: app builds and launches with real maps (verified); release.sh builds, signs ad-hoc and checks app + dmg (BUNDLE OK); the disk image install is rehearsed by scripts/dmg_install_check.sh (quarantine, mount, copy, verify) but has not been opened in Finder by a human; the desktop app was rebuilt from the landed tree

bars.label: Real full verify green (scenario sections per job, real parallel log)
bars.note: batch 3 and batch 4 full verify_parallel.sh 6 runs both ALL JOBS PASSED (193 and 194 scenarios; batch 4 with no retry at all); batch 6a: 5 of 6 jobs green, the 6th red only on a scenario that crossed the new level quest gates (fixed in the scenario, passed alone); batch 6b run 31638 and batch 7 run 7644 passed (6th and 7th clean in a row); batch 8 run 36803 had two red scenarios (92-objects2, 93-objects-gaps; fixed and re-run alone, no clean full run on the final tree); batch 9 run 98647 passed fully, so the current streak is 1 clean full verify

v1.title: Game v1 complete
v1.definition: v1 = a person double-clicks the Mac app, makes or loads a character and can play Acts 1-5 single player (quests, items, skills, monsters, saves, without hitting a blocker; multiplayer through the game screen and Hell-difficulty polish count too. The percentage is a weighted average of the measurable bars below; dashed = on branches, not yet verified.

items.label: Acts played start to finish by a human tester
items.note: a human plays each act start to finish; moved out of v1 by the project owner on 2026-10-10

items.label: Sound and music confirmed by a human listen
items.note: a human listens to menu music, NPC voices, footsteps, spell sounds and ambience; moved out of v1 by the project owner on 2026-10-10 (sound is implemented and scripted-checked; the human confirmation is v2)
